resolution.note: krn brief lens prints non-N/A Hardening answers as accepted residuals

title: Generate the review lens from Settled decisions and accepted Hardening residuals
body: Outcome: krn brief lens also prints the brief's Hardening answers that accept a residual (race, symlink, stale-state) verbatim, so the panel does not re-flag accepted residuals as BLOCKING. Evidence: PR #192 attempt 2 FAIL on the task-guard race and symlink swap, both accepted in brief Hardening but absent from the lens; lead override spent (.krn/runs/lead/brief-guard/override.txt). Proof: test/brief/lens.test.ts red at base by assertion.
